positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Solventum
- Enhanced Legacy Code & Issue Resolution: Quickly adapted legacy code to handle critical customer issues from an early stage, ensuring minimal disruption.
- Scalable Architecture & Performance Optimization: Designed and developed robust iOS SDK and application using Swift, Objective C, improving background/foreground experience using Multithreading Programming, memory management, and event handling for seamless app performance.
- SDK Development(Health care): Implemented and maintained both iOS and Android SDKs , ensuring feature parity and smooth integration for client applications.
- Collaborative Development: Worked closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions in Agile/Scrum environments, conducted code reviews.
- Defect resolution & Continuous Improvement: Diagnosed and resolved critical bugs, optimized performance, and contributed to major releases.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: Overland Park, Kansas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Captel (VoIP, Accessibility, Secure Storage): Developed a VoIP application for individuals with hearing loss, implementing SIP-based captioning, secure AES-256 encrypted storage for captions and voicemails, and dynamic, reusable UI following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.
- MySprint (Embedded Frameworks, Apple Business Chat): Built an embedded iOS framework to share code between Apple Business Chat extensions and the main app, integrating features like plan management, billing, Apple Pay, and payment arrangements.
- Virgin Mobile (End-to-End Development, Payments, SiriKit): Led development from scratch by leveraging the Sprint app’s codebase, implementing key features like biometric authentication, payments, promotional offers, and a SiriKit-based virtual assistant POC for bill inquiries.
- Scalable Solutions: Modular Design, Scalable Architecture, optimized performance, and enhanced security across multiple mobile applications, ensuring seamless user experience and high maintainability.
- Accessibility & User-Centric Enhancements: Ensured app-wide accessibility compliance, supporting features for vision and hearing-impaired users, while improving UI/UX for diverse user needs.
